subject: general
question: What is the name of the portal launched to foster water innovation by the Ministry of Jal Shakti during the launch of the ‘Jal Shakti Hackathon-2025’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat-WIN Portal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

 
• **The Ministry of Jal Shakti launched the Bharat-WIN (Water Innovation Network) portal alongside the Jal Shakti Hackathon-2025 to promote water-sector innovation.**
